workouts.title: RUN row
workouts.description:
3 Rounds:

1:00 Row @ pace 1
200 m recovery Run
1:00 Row @ pace 2
200 m recovery Run
1:00 Row @ pace 3

Rest 2:00


decide on 3 paces:
1 - moderate pace feels comfortable for 1:00 work and suits long workouts 
2 - fast pace sustainable for 1:00 but feels uncomfortable suits shorter workouts or the last set of workout
3 - the fastest and the most uncomfortable pace that you can sustain for 1:00

note the number of Cals done each set and note the pace for each set!
